sourceContract: Current main buildMarketFeatures() + strategySetupState() semantics as audited at main 859d2ef2691564afc6ee863bdf62755d3ef25544.

bStrongCloseDominatesUpperShadow.zeroRangeEdge: When high=low, current features set closePosition=0.5 and upperShadow=0; strongClose fails, so upperShadow still cannot be the sole blocker after strongClose passes.
implication: A coherent row can never have B strongClose=true and upperShadow=false.
upperShadow can never be the only failed B check.
Treating strongClose and upperShadow as two independent Hamming dimensions inflates setup distance when candle-close geometry is weak.
Formal behavior is unchanged; this is a research-distance/redundancy finding only.
bStrongCloseDominatesUpperShadow.feasibleMaskConsequence: With B mask order trend,breakout,volume,strongClose,upperShadow,notLate, all masks containing strongClose=1 and upperShadow=0 are structurally impossible under coherent OHLC features (16 of 64 raw bit patterns).

bNotLateRet20Branch.proof: lateStage=(ret20>35 OR maDistance20Pct>25) while B also requires ret20<=30; therefore the ret20>35 arm of lateStage cannot be the binding reason once ret20<=30 passes. Under coherent features B notLate reduces to ret20<=30 AND maDistance20Pct<=25.

aSupportStructureConditionalOverlap.proof: When chooseDailySupport selects a filtered candidate, candidate<=close*1.015 implies close/candidate>=1/1.015≈0.98522, which already satisfies structure close>=support*0.985. The clause can still bind on the unfiltered ma20 fallback.
aSupportStructureConditionalOverlap.implication: Future research observer should preserve supportSource and fallback state before interpreting close-vs-support structure margin as independent evidence.

futureResearchGroups: B candle-close geometry: strongClose primary inequality; upperShadow retained as nested descriptive shape, not an independent distance dimension.
B notLate: ret20<=30 and maDistance20Pct<=25 as separate raw margins.
A support geometry: support distance plus priorLow structure, with supportSource/fallback provenance.
A volume: preserve both OR-branch margins; no averaging.

falsificationConditions: If production dailyClosePosition or dailyUpperShadowRatio are sourced from non-OHLC external fields rather than buildMarketFeatures, dominance must be revalidated for those rows.
If future code changes either threshold away from the exact complementary 0.65/0.35 pair, the algebraic implication may no longer hold.
If support selection semantics change, the A conditional-overlap finding must be revalidated.
